The cut has a better way: the HTML attribute `dir` on `<html>` or on an element around the parts. Each part reads the direction of its own element (rule 8.16), so its CSS and its keys agree. A popup in `<body>` has the direction of `<html dir>`. A part that places content by the direction in the server HTML, such as `Slider.Root`, takes `dir` on its own element.
